screen: SEASON STATS — KICK RETURN, scope NATIONAL, sorted by AVG descending
method: Twenty-nine stills, each one screenful, overlapping its predecessor by one row. Read from the 5712-pixel originals rather than a downscaled copy: at 1600 pixels wide a 392 was misread as 382, which the yards-per-return identity caught.
validation: YARDS / KR = AVG on all 313 rows, and AVG never increases down the list. The last still ends with the highlight on the final row, so the list is complete.
teams: No team column on this screen; the card beside the highlighted row is the only attribution and was not transcribed per still.
